title: CaseAssigned.v1
description: Payload of the CaseAssigned event (A§23). Emitted by case-service — the single producer (A§7.2) — on every successful `POST /v1/cases/{caseId}/assign`, including reassignment (A§15, D§6). Published on `collections.case` keyed by `caseId`, so assignment order for a case is guaranteed and the last event wins (A§26). An assignment must name a team, a collector, or both: an event with neither carries no information and is rejected by the schema. Only the assignment delta travels; the rest of the case is read through `GET /v1/cases/{caseId}`. Rides the A§24 envelope; a breaking change ships as CaseAssigned.v2 (D§29).

caseId.description: Platform identifier of the case that was assigned. Equal to the envelope `aggregateId` and the Kafka partition key (A§26).

assignedTeam.description: Collections team the case now belongs to, or null when the case is assigned to an individual collector without a team. A team code from the operational org model, not a platform ULID.

assignedCollector.description: Identity of the collector the case is now assigned to (the identity-provider subject, which is what the collector workbench and `GET /v1/cases?assignedCollector=` filter on), or null for a team-only assignment awaiting pickup. Not a platform ULID: it is owned by the identity provider (A§61).
